_comment: Per-cell metadata the records do not print in a parseable line: language, where the cell ran, how the repo was chosen, a short label and a note. Numbers never live here — they are read from docs/oracle-cells/ (ADR-102).

ajv-ts.label: ajv
ajv-ts.note: the one open semantic defect: a member call on a union-typed receiver (static→union-member, n=1)

cheerio-ts.label: cheerio
cheerio-ts.note: 44 abstract: calls through const x = factory(..) (H-18)

click-py.label: click
click-py.note: trace-graded under its own suite; 16 of 18 suspects are C-60's override/monkeypatch asymmetry

dagger-go.label: dagger
dagger-go.note: 19 Go modules of the monorepo, one dot each; the root module is not graded (H-9)

dagger-rust.label: dagger sdk/rust
dagger-rust.note: misses are code macros and derives wrote

fzf-go.label: fzf
fzf-go.note: 87 syntactic edges vetoed by the Go scope rule before the regrade (ADR-090)

jsoup-java.label: jsoup
jsoup-java.note: interface→method against the CHA override set is the majority miss

kbet-ts.label: kbet (private app)
kbet-ts.note: a private Vite+React app: the cell is published, the repo is not

mux-go.label: mux
mux-go.note: 3 abstract: calls through a package-level func variable (H-18)

quic-go-go.label: quic-go
quic-go-go.note: random draw; binary roots only (the full test program OOM-killed the box); all 15 contradictions are the test build's shadowing methods, 0 hobbes-wrong

rust_proj.label: rust_proj
rust_proj.note: tiny crate; misses are criterion_group! bodies

severed-chains-java.label: Severed-Chains
severed-chains-java.note: random draw; lane B failed on this Gradle build (C-67), so every edge is syntactic — C-8's floor measured
